summary: Idaho County lookout: 30-foot tower with L-4 cab, built 1933 in Nez Perce NF and destroyed 1957; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1957; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: 30-foot tower with L-4 cab, about 2.5 miles west of Fenn Ranger Station

evidence.supports: built 1933 as a 30-foot L-4 tower; 2.5 miles west of Fenn; destroyed 1957
evidence.quote: 1933: 30' L-4 tower. Located 2.5 miles west of Fenn R.S. Destroyed 1957.

evidence.supports: built 1933 with L-4 cab on 30-foot tower
about two and a half miles west of Fenn Ranger Station
evidence.quote: 2 ½ miles W of Fenn RS

evidence.supports: built 1933 as a 30-foot L-4 tower; destroyed 1957

corrections.why: The record holds the state name. firelookout.com gives Idaho County, Idaho, and the Forest Lookouts Idaho County list includes Hot Point.

notes_for_editor: Dates, design and agency agree across all four sources. No source describes remains or public access; Idaho Fire Lookouts says hike-in only. Staffing: Idaho Fire Lookouts says no staffing history is documented, so no staffing facts were recorded. Location: the FFLA list coordinates (46.10152, -115.6) match the Idaho Fire Lookouts map pin, so no location conflict.
